The loopback allow-list change directly fixes the 1.6.2 socket-server runtime failure without skipping execution or weakening its assertions. Final coverage passes the ordered repair gate: overall 16/17 to 18/19, reflection 15/15 to 17/17, and resources remains 1/2. The exact Forge finalization completed all three test lanes, metadata and style checks, generated-test validation, and statistics generation, then passed again without changing the publishable tree.
